decision: Preserve and disclose all results; no selective exclusion, rerun, simulator/model/code change, or claim of exact image identity for every case. This audit does not establish zero causal effect of the small image discrepancy and does not relax the separate cross-GPU deployment gate.
scope: Initial conditions and first model request only; subsequent closed-loop observations are expected to diverge. Not an audit of all future results.
